purpose.zh: 让胯慢慢转到最大，活动开
purpose.en: Moves your hip slowly through the biggest circle it can to keep it loose.

text.zh: 膝盖抬起来，画一个你能画的最大的圈
text.en: Lift your knee and draw the biggest circle you can

text.zh: 屁股和背不动，只有腿在转。
text.en: Hips and back stay still. Only the leg moves.

text.zh: 画一圈算 1 下，下一圈反着画。
text.en: One circle counts as one. Go the other way on the next one.

cautions.zh: 胯不舒服就把圈画小点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your hip feels off, make the circle smaller. Stop if it still hurts.

cautions.zh: 跪撑手腕不舒服就撑拳头，膝盖下垫软
cautions.en: Press on your fists if your wrists complain, and pad your knees.
